mapper.select: SELECT C_BIG_CD, C_SMALL_CD, S_VALUE, CASE C_BIG_CD WHEN '10' THEN '메인배너' WHEN '20' THEN '개발자정보' WHEN '30' THEN '연락처' ELSE '기타' END AS BIG_NM, CASE CONCAT(C_BIG_CD, C_SMALL_CD) WHEN '10001' THEN '배너이미지경로' WHEN '10002' THEN '배너텍스트' WHEN '20001' THEN '개발자이름' WHEN '20002' THEN '직급' WHEN '20003' THEN '프로필이미지경로' WHEN '20004' THEN '소개텍스트' WHEN '20005' THEN '핵심메시지' WHEN '20006' THEN '기술태그(#구분)' WHEN '30001' THEN '이메일' WHEN '30002' THEN '전화번호' WHEN '30003' THEN '카카오톡ID' ELSE C_SMALL_CD END AS SMALL_NM FROM T_LD_CODE ORDER BY C_BIG_CD, C_SMALL_CD
SELECT C_BIG_CD, C_SMALL_CD, S_VALUE FROM T_LD_CODE WHERE C_BIG_CD = #{bigCd} ORDER BY C_SMALL_CD
